## Freed v26.9.600

Explore an illustrated Freed demo, navigate connected profiles in Friends, and cache profile avatars in Freed Desktop

### Features

- Explore 307 illustrated demo entries through the feed, visual Stories, Friends and map, with a welcome guide you can minimize for your next visit
- Navigate people, connected profiles and recent posts in Friends with editable care ratings, map previews, and animated labels and avatars
- Cache identity and profile avatars locally in Freed Desktop, including profiles you have not opened yet

### Fixes

- Synchronize Friends and All content filters across views, with All content selected by default
- Show demo totals and unread counts, resetting read status and care edits on reload while preserving theme and welcome-guide preferences
- Link author names to Friends and recent activity cards to the feed reader
- Improve narrow-screen banner controls, coordinated transitions and theme-aware hover effects
- Add searchable notes to saved content
- LinkedIn feed extraction after reconnecting and support updated feed markup restored
- Preserve pending provider syncs during temporary writer admission failures and recognize unlocked macOS sessions correctly
- Keep snapshot exports off the Desktop command thread and seek directly to checkpoint pages
- Support larger Drive checkpoint publications, coalesce overlapping exports and stop attempts that cease making progress
- Recover the PWA Library after worker loss and report another tab holding the Library as busy
- Repair PWA startup, sample population, reset and credential-update races
- Refine the existing SQLite Library with normalized storage and sync records, local-only authority initialization, and retirement of older representations

### Follow-ups

- The demo currently contains 265 regular entries and 42 visual Stories; the separate expansion to 900 regular entries and 100 Stories is still in progress
- Verify Drive publication and connected-provider behavior on the signed production build

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
